base_commit_note: Development revision that preceded the published history; the published history begins at fa9691d8f232cd3763bc1850ab9ff40fcafe7a46. The checks below were executed on that revision with the runtime fingerprint recorded in source_sha256.
scope: Current-source software, mathematics, printed arithmetic, source correspondence and evidence-import validation. Original benchmark observations were not available and were not reproduced.
source_fingerprint_scope: cross_morse/ and runtime Python entry points; the experiment executor, campaign audit, paper tooling, documentation and tests are additionally identified by the Git revision and release checksums.

skip_scope.full_suite: Private cluster profile excluded from the public package
skip_scope.no_torch: PyTorch-dependent cases; exercised separately by the full CPU suite

environment.scope: package versions and Python major/minor/platform; not wheel hashes, native-library identity or GPU compatibility

analytical_statements.scope: Seeded numerical checks under stated hypotheses, not a formal proof

supplementary_arithmetic.scope: Relationships among printed inputs; advisory interpretations and rounding are retained

model_inventory.scope: Full-profile model instantiation and parameter counts; not historical checkpoint equivalence

experiment_execution.scope: Includes actual trained synthetic E6 execution, immutable operation-bound replay, exact-cap comparator fallback and infeasibility; no benchmark performance inference

diagram_checks.scope: SVG and PNG-source fingerprints; revised evidence-chain layout visually inspected

manuscript_review.reviewed_by: ChatGPT: AI-assisted contextual review requested by author

scientific_audit.confirmation_scope: Original unrounded heterogeneous test outputs, paired means, joint nine-test Holm decisions and native-run links; original test programs are preserved and hashed but their raw P values are not recomputed by this gate.
scientific_audit.release_scope: This release distributes code and regenerates its results (release/release_scope.json: result_distribution = regenerate). The gate's blockers are the registrations of a release that publishes archives; run_cross_morse.sh reproduce regenerates the lifecycle runs, and its report compares them with the paper.

smoke_runs.scope: fresh CPU synthetic lifecycle exercising non-default encoder, head and GINE widths; no official benchmark data
smoke_runs.outcome: comparator retained; no performance improvement claim

smoke_runs_history_note: The smoke_runs entries preserve the earlier validation event at the same core runtime identity. They are not claimed as newly executed benchmark runs in this revision; current E6 synthetic execution is covered above.

historical_examples.scope: sealed synthetic observations; separate from current-runtime execution

reproduction_launcher_validation.validated_tree: the commit that adds this record
reproduction_launcher_validation.scope: Reproduction launcher run_cross_morse.sh, scripts/reproduction.py, the code-release scope of the generated views and the hpc/ drivers' use of the launcher's site settings. Slurm, the GPU and the Python runtime of a job are simulated; no benchmark data, training or GPU execution.

environment.scope: development sandbox, not the recorded CPU environment; PyTorch-dependent tests were not executed in this revision

launcher_tests.simulated_cluster: stub sbatch, squeue, sacct, scontrol (requeue, node exclusion), sinfo, module and nvidia-smi; a runner stub that writes complete runs, checkpoints, fails or returns without its artifact
scenarios: check: runtime identity, configurations and the job plan with the paper's GPU-hours; nothing written or submitted; an empty account is refused
a modified runtime is refused by check and reproduce unless CM_ALLOW_SOURCE_CHANGE=1, which the suite manifest records
reproduce: numbered suite, frozen run sources, the Roman-empire campaign and the setup -> runs (afterok) -> report (afterany) job graph with its job table
a dataset wrapper reproduces only its dataset
setup, single runs and the ten Roman-empire array tasks executed; status, report, GPU-hours from accounting, run registry, live log and a redacted results ZIP
checkpointed requeue of the same job at the time limit; a continuation job where requeue is refused; continuation budget exhausted (exit 75, TIME_BUDGET)
GPU or driver failure: node excluded and job requeued; GPU health failure
report deferred while runs are queued; reproduce resume skips complete and queued runs
site-env prints the effective settings that the hpc/ drivers read; help and usage

scripts/reproduction.py: fingerprint, compute reference, dataset selection, run state, scheduler parsing, suite creation, report beside the paper, tables rebuilt from a suite, refused comparison reported, status

preserved_scientific_inputs.changed_scope: site profiles of the launcher; no configuration, runtime, example or registry file changed

local_container_execution: not performed; inspect the hosted container workflow for the published commit
